verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Nobody knows how weak I am
Better than You

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Nobody sees all of my needs
Better than You

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
And nobody has
the power to change me
To what I was born to be

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
Jesus be strong in my weakness
Empower me

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Empower me, like a rushing river
Flowing to the sea

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Lord, send Your Holy Spirit
Flowing now through me

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
Till I'm living as Your child
victorious and free

verse.name: c1d
verse.lines:
Send the power of Your love
empower me.

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Nobody's eyes see through my soul
Better than Yours

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Nobody's love can make me whole
No one but Yours

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
And nobody has the power to lift me
To reach for eternity

verse.name: v2d
verse.lines:
Jesus break through all my defences,
Empower me
